definition: Time-weighted planar Gazebo ground-truth speed. Flat intervals require both ends abs(roll/pitch)<0.04 rad. Means include startup/deceleration/stops during each goal, excluding inter-goal waits.
notes: Baseline and final vehicle_height remain 0.040 m; 0.240 m was tried only in a temporary obstacle experiment and did not solve that experiment.
The first two obstacle placements were outside the unmodified route and are not evidence that on-path dynamic avoidance works.

On-path obstacle at (-12.95,0.5), 0.4x0.4x0.8 m, caused contact/stall with both original and raised speeds. Raw/registered clouds at the starting pose contained zero points within the box neighbourhood; no definite root cause is claimed from this alone.
The independent obstacle perception/classification limitation is unresolved. Dynamic collision/freshness checks were not disabled.
All raw launch/ROS/timing logs remain under /tmp/nav_flat_speed_20261031.
